intelligence.title: Smart Access — The Lock, Not the Course
intelligence.ingest_note: Shawn's Smart Access doctrine (2026-11-05 ~11:13 PST, this chat): a membership is a lock, not a course; the name 'Smart Access pages' settled by Shawn as the standing term. Filed by Naya Resolve Narzan under the Flywheel order. Census at main tip 8762a4478f8b: registry (1114 entries) held no SN-2055; no page/capture on main; open PR heads checked.
intelligence.essence: A membership is a lock, not a course. Smart Access pages put anything digital — one video, one audio, a PDF, a book, a whole course — behind a login only the right people pass: those who paid, or those the owner lets in free for a taste.
intelligence.human_view: Memberships are how a citizen stores everything they make and chooses exactly who gets in. The lock does not promise a course — it protects whatever is behind it, big or small. Free access is a feature, not a leak: a taster brings people in, and the deeper work sits behind the next door, priced by the owner.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a door with a lock. Behind it you can keep one video, one song, one book — or a whole school. Only people with the key can open it. You can give a key to someone who paid, or lend one free so they can peek. That is a Smart Access page.
intelligence.grandma_view: You do not need a big course to sell something, dear. Put your one best video, or your recipe book, behind your page's lock. People you invite can look free; everyone else pays a little. It is your door and your key — nobody opens it but who you choose.
intelligence.naya_view: Smart Access is the sellable layer of every world: content-agnostic locking over digital goods, with owner-controlled free and paid keys, ambassador links per product, and all movement counted by the Smart Ledger. When a Naya designs a membership surface, she designs locks and keys — never course-shaped assumptions.
intelligence.ai_view: Smart Access generalizes the paywall into a primitive: any digital object, one lock, two key types (paid, granted). It composes with Smart Links for purchase, the Ledger for proof, and ambassadors for distribution — the smallest unit of the network's economy.
intelligence.machine_view: SMART_ACCESS{object: any_digital, lock: login_gate, keys: [paid, granted_free], name: 'Smart Access pages' (canonical), ambassadors: per_product, proof: smart_ledger}
